description:
Look at Google, a page or the sitemap as it is right now. rank spends one of the plan's rank checks (30 per day), the other checks are free.
check:
- rank(keyword, depth?): Where the site ranks for a search now (to position 30, depth 10 to 50), the top 10 and the AI Overview's sites, beside Search Console's average. 30 per day.
- index(url): Whether one of the site's pages is in Google's index, and why not, with the day Google last read it. 50 per day.
- serp(keyword): One keyword's Google page: the top 10 with each page's type and whose it is, the AI Overview and its sources, People Also Ask, the keyword's numbers, and the tracked prompts asking it. Read it before writing for a keyword.
- page(url): Read a page as a crawler without JavaScript: title, meta, canonical, headings, words, schema, and on the site's own pages what keeps it out of Google or AI answers. Another site's page: its outline only. 50 per day.
- crawl(sitemapUrl?, limit?): Fetch every page the site's sitemap lists: status, redirect, title, canonical, noindex, words and the problems. Up to 500 pages, 5 crawls per day, own site only.
name: check_web
title: Check the web now
